claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a white console with a PlayStation logo; the witness identifies it as a Sony PlayStation 5.
The report does not state whether the console is the original larger model or the slimmer revision.
The photos do not show region, plug type, or usage history.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a white game controller with the console.

risks.risk: Console does not power on, read discs, or play games.
risks.proof: Video clip of the console booting to the system menu and running a game or disc.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working console for parts only.

risks.risk: It is the digital model or has unknown storage capacity.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear model label or system settings showing storage and disc drive presence.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a digital edition with unknown storage.

risks.risk: Power cable, HDMI cable, or original box is missing.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included cables and packaging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console and controller only, with no cables or box.

risks.risk: Ports, buttons, or controller battery are worn or faulty.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports and buttons plus a clip of the controller connecting and holding a charge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with worn ports and a controller battery that may not hold charge.

risks.risk: Age, usage history, or warranty status is unknown.
risks.proof: Proof of purchase or warranty card.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as out of warranty with unknown usage.

proof_requests: Video of the console turning on and playing a game or disc.
Photo of the rear label showing model and storage.
Photo of any included cables and box.
Close-up of controller and ports, plus clip of controller charging.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Sony PlayStation 5 with one controller, so a worst-case price is possible; unproven claims about model variant, region, functionality, and accessories are treated as risks that would raise the price if verified.
